title: Against The Achilles’ Heel: A Survey on Red Teaming for Generative Models

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying red teaming methods that measure model vulnerability across different languages, specifically comparing Attack Success Rates (ASR) of malicious prompts translated into low-resource versus high-resource languages.
Reviewing comprehensive safety benchmarks (e.g., ToxicGen, DICES, and CValues) that evaluate generative models for implicit representational harms, discrimination, and stereotypical features.
Reviewing multimodal red teaming datasets (e.g., RTVLM) that benchmark vision-language models on visual fairness, including face fairness and safe demographic representations.
